primary.title: US Fed leaves federal funds rate unchanged: How can a status quo impact the Indian stock market?
primary.summary: The US Federal Reserve kept rates unchanged on 29 July. While the decision may ease foreign capital outflows and strengthen the rupee, looming inflation risks and geopolitical tensions remain significant concerns for investors.
